Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm of Tiny beasts's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm of Tiny beasts has half of its hit points or fewer.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by a swarm of Tiny beasts is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and paralyzed while poisoned in this way.
